title: Stress-estimator pairing audit: which pressure belongs in I, which stress in mu
question: Rounds 24-33 judged (mu_bulk, I_measured) against the 2-D ruler, where mu_bulk is the Love-Weber *contact* stress of the whole cell and I_measured uses the *profile* contact-only pressure of the central band. Do the other, equally admissible stress channels move the judged error across the 10 % acceptance band? If yes, the residual (+19..27 %) is not identifiable as a physics error from a single pairing.

protocol.note: round-31/33 short protocol, identical to runs/wall_translation_r33/smoke_filled_n310_wfixed_I0.05_s0.json (a *diagnostic*, not anchor evidence)

predictions.P1_kinetic_share_of_normal_stress_gt_0.1: the profile's kinetic part carries >15 % of the normal stress at I=0.05, so contact-only and total stress are NOT interchangeable
predictions.P2_pressure_channel_spread_gt_1.15: max/min over {p_wall, p_bulk, p_profile_contact, p_profile_total} exceeds 1.15 within one run
predictions.P3_error_spread_gt_10pp: the mu error against the ruler, taken over the four self-consistent pairings {(mu_X, p_X)}, spans more than 10 percentage points at a fixed run -> a single-pairing PASS/FAIL is not identifiable at the anchor's tolerance
predictions.P4_falsifier: if the spread under P3 is <2 percentage points, the pairing is irrelevant and the residual must be attributed to physics; the harness-defect hypothesis is then falsified

decisions_fixed_in_advance.if_P3_holds: report every pairing, adopt the dimension-consistent (total,total) pairing as the default judging convention for the cj4610 campaign, and mark the legacy single-pairing verdict WITHHELD rather than FAIL
decisions_fixed_in_advance.if_P4_holds: keep the legacy pairing, record the residual as physics, and close the harness question
